notes: v0.6.11: fix the Update button to move HEAD when pulling a new tag. The Update button's git checkout command was `git checkout -f <tag> -- .` — the trailing `-- .` limited the checkout to working-tree files only, leaving HEAD at whatever it was before. The launcher's version page reads `git describe --tags --abbrev=0` which follows HEAD, so after a successful Update the page reported the OLD tag (e.g. "Your version: v0.6.5") even when files were at v0.6.10. Discovered during the g90digi v0.6.10 deploy when the operator saw "Your version: v0.6.5 / Latest: v0.6.10 / out of date" despite all 12 components being green. Fix: drop the trailing `-- .` so HEAD moves to the new tag. Safe because deployed boxes don't have local commits to preserve. After this release, every successful Update button click will report the correct version on /launcher-status automatically — no manual `git checkout -f <tag>` needed.
